summary: Saved validation predictions and metrics are internally reproducible with real station GHI, but batch repetition, coarse early validation, effective-capacity mismatch, validation reuse, and single-station old-split scope prevent a causal claim that COT itself degrades GHI.

gt_provenance.details: Observed station GHI is the target/evaluation source and is not a model input; unit metadata is inferred rather than explicit.

score_normalization.details: Metrics are recomputed in raw W/m2 without self-normalization; low-clear-sky extreme kt remains a modeling warning.

result_existence.details: All nine predictions exist on identical 5855-row support and reproduce stored RMSE and bootstrap intervals.

dead_code.details: The as-run manifest alias check was vacuous; a post-run audit used the correct fields and passed.

scope.details: Old-split Sili-only validation uses the same validation set for checkpoint selection, reporting, and bootstrap; not a new-monthly, two-station, test, or deployment result.

training_protocol.details: Batch 8192 repeats 4041 unique rows; first validation occurs after about 202.7 effective epochs, COT arms overfit earlier, and effective capacity is not strictly matched.

claims.claim: Under the audited old-split Sili validation protocol, saved transport and hybrid candidates have higher mean RMSE than A.
Historical or forecast COT itself causes GHI degradation.
The current COT arms overfit earlier and more severely on the recorded validation grid.
The result generalizes to the new monthly split, two Hunan stations, independent test, or deployment.

posthoc_followup.scope: Post-hoc early-checkpoint replay and union selection on the same old-split Sili validation set; not independent confirmation.

step100_replay.details: All nine step100 RMSE, MAE, and bias values match the original curves exactly. Five runs also have original saved arrays that match elementwise; four lack original step100 arrays.

union_selection_fairness.details: A, transport, and hybrid each receive the same 21 candidate steps, initialization contract, training stream, validation rows and GT, and RMSE selection rule.

posthoc_followup.claim_impact: The original higher-RMSE finding is restricted to the coarse 100-step checkpoint grid. The union diagnostic neither confirms a COT gain nor supports a claim that COT is generally harmful.

alignment_followup.details: Four selected validation cases reproduce time, row, canonical lead, center crop, support, geometry, and pack handoff. This is sampled evidence and does not prove all-bank physical or geographic correctness.

mandatory_fixes: Qualify the step100 exact-reproduction caption to distinguish five elementwise checks from four metric-only checks.
Move or restyle the hybrid -0.97 label so its minus sign is visible.
State that the early-curve shading is the three-seed min-max range and that the dotted training curve is one repeated 8192-row batch, not a full-train metric.
Replace physical COT with retrieval/model proxy COT, label observed AGRI to frozen R as a post-hoc proxy, and state that future observed AGRI is diagnostic-only.
Do not label sequence2312 as the largest deterioration without a saved filter; call it a high-deterioration case.
